hypothesis: Existing task-family TV-triggered refresh can detect a visible family shift, but cannot detect exploitation within a constant family; periodic calibration is a falsification baseline.
scope: Known-ground-truth synthetic exogenous policies; no LLM, optimizer, new refresh algorithm, capability gain or learned policy-verifier co-evolution claim.
cheaper_gate: Two deterministic controls verify family-TV blindness and bounded calibration fitting first.
refresh_budget: At most two refreshes of64 labeled calibration rows. Equal maximum budget, not equal actual label spend; report spend per strategy.
shift: Use existing DistributionShiftMonitor(window256), initial reference familyA. Refresh when TV>.25, refit family reference on refresh.
verifier: Default visible-test proxy; calibration fits transparent per(feature,proxy) majority truth table; no independent audit labels enter fitting/decisions.
policy_schedule: Rounds0-3 ordinaryquality.7/attack0; rounds4-7 quality.72/attack.4; rounds8-11 quality.9/attack.15. Attack alwaysincorrect but proxypositive. Visible attackfamilyB; hidden attackfamilyA. Baselineordinaryquality.7 throughout.
independence: Deterministic RNG namespaces per seed/scenario/round/split; untouched independent candidate/baseline label streams are never passed to refresh. Streams matched across strategies.
promotion: Existing PromotionGate, min primary gain.03, n256. Report proxy-only counterfactual false promotions/missed improvements relative to the independent truth gate. This is not neural checkpoint publication.
acceptance: All declared cohorts emitted; budgets bounded; independent-label isolation; hidden shift must expose family-TV blind spot. No winning strategy required; retain null/negative results.
budget: 6 sequential CPU cases,60s each, no API/GPU/services.
abort: First correctness/resource failure; preserve failed outputs; do not tune threshold or schedule after observation.
decision: Keep existing refresh interface and report the observable blind spot. Do not introduce a new refresh algorithm from this fixture alone.
